description: Opens ML Kit's document scanner (BASE mode, gallery import) for up to maxPages pages (1 to 10; 10 when left out). The user crops, reorders and retakes in the scanner. The pages are copied upright into the app's data folder and returned as data-relative paths, in the order the user left them. Leaving the scanner without pages is a result (cancelled), not an error.

errors.description: The scanner cannot run on this phone right now: Google Play services missing or outdated, the scanner module not available, no usable camera.
